title: Peak: Secrets from the New Science of Expertise
reason: As a cross-disciplinary student operating at the intersection of finance/economics and cardiology, I prioritise Achievement as my primary value and require a rigorous, evidence-based framework for accelerating expertise acquisition. 'Peak' by Ericsson operationalises deliberate practice theory with empirical precision — its quantitative, science-backed methodology maps directly onto my visual and technical learning preferences. The sub-£20 price point aligns with my value-driven spending posture, and the content delivers high ROI for a self-taught student who must compress domain expertise across two demanding fields. The cross-disciplinary cognitive science underpinning the book mirrors my own research approach. 😊📊
